# The pipeline version changes in the middle of a backfill. Version 1 loads 3 days of 6, then the budget stops it and the item is cancelled.
# PIPE_VERSION changes to 2 with no file edit, and a new item for the same range starts. The plan selects every day that is below version 2, so the 3 days of
# version 1 load again, with new chunk items, and the other 3 days load once. The warehouse then holds version 2 for all 6 days.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:sqlite3] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

pipeinit
pipefakes
env HOME=$WORK/home
env PIPE_DIR=$WORK/pl
env PIPE_HOME=$WORK/pipe
env PIPE_VERSION=1
replace pl/version.star 'CHUNK = 100' 'CHUNK = 2'

exec obeereal item add pipeline bf-1 --title 'May at version 1' --body-file body.txt
! exec obeereal run bf-1 pipeline --workflow pl/backfill.star &
waitstatus 'paused: The budget of 3 cents is spent'
exec obeereal cancel bf-1
wait
exec sqlite3 pipe/warehouse.db 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM manifest WHERE version = "1"'
stdout '^3$'
grep -count=3 '^classify ' calls.log

env PIPE_VERSION=2
exec obeereal item add pipeline bf-2 --title 'May at version 2' --body-file body2.txt
exec obeereal run bf-2 pipeline --workflow pl/backfill.star
stdout 'item bf-2 finished'
exec sqlite3 pipe/warehouse.db 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM manifest WHERE version = "2"'
stdout '^6$'
exec sqlite3 pipe/warehouse.db 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM manifest WHERE version = "1"'
stdout '^0$'
# The three days of version 1 were labeled again, and the other three once. The rows of a day were replaced, not added.
grep -count=9 '^classify ' calls.log
grep -count=2 '^classify 2026-05-01$' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^classify 2026-05-06$' calls.log
exec sqlite3 pipe/warehouse.db 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM labeled'
stdout '^18$'

-- body.txt --
2026-05-01 2026-05-06 3
-- body2.txt --
2026-05-01 2026-05-06 100
-- pipe/config --
SOURCE_API=http://source.test
-- pipe/credential.header --
X-Token: TESTONLY
